historical_context.time_period: Kalsa's standing present during the commissioned Ashen Intake descent; the exact date remains unresolved.
historical_context.location: The dry Custodian Gallery beneath Low Sere, with one return toward the Eight Screens and one archive crawl through the Memorial Sump to the Relief Crawl.
historical_context.summary: Sera Venn opens Teren's calibration chest and discovers two notices that could have changed the Grey Scald's warning and aftercare. The party must decide how much provenance to preserve, what to copy first, and which specialist or recorder may risk the route back to lower-step households while the intake pressure clock continues.

public_facts.text: Low Sere's forty-one hearths depend on warm water from an old intake; lower-step rooms are wetter, poorer, and first harmed when ash enters the channels.
The Grey Scald killed Jori Kes and Pell Am and injured three other workers after public and inherited warnings disagreed about an interval.

Sera holds technical threshold authority, Ressa offers independent comparison, Tavi carries a kin claim, Maro speaks for surface admission and basin action, and Bel Orra speaks as a lower-step water witness.

ambient_pressures.text: Two notices contain actionable platform-clearance and lower-step aftercare instructions, but their damaged routing tags support accusations without identifying who made either original hold.

Preserving the brittle tags and making three copies consumes time under a pressure clock; rushing preserves actionability while degrading the evidence needed to contest the offices that withheld notice.
Every fast disclosure route removes a bounded authority from the repair party or exposes a record carrier to heat, unstable passage, and ambiguous manifestations.
Teren's counterseal proves later preservation and withholding, not authorship of the earlier holds or innocence in the wider failure.

groups.label: Custodian Gallery review party
institutional_logic: Recover and preserve evidence while retaining the technical, mortuary, movement, and record authorities needed to survive the Intake Crown.
internal_shames: A beautiful record delivered after the casualty
Calling route loss an archival accident
prestige_markers: A copy that survives independent comparison
A stop obeyed before machinery accepts a bad act
A courier plan that names what leaves with the courier
taboo_triggers: Treating the notices as a verdict
Calling manifestations witnesses without a mortuary record
Using urgency to erase the compact's copy owners
emotional_display_norms: Fear is compressed into counts, corrections, dry jokes, contested hands on documents, and arguments over who has to walk the hot route.
trust_defaults: Trusts separated copies, visible marks, material comparison, and bounded testimony more than confident office or a convenient confession.

groups.label: Lower-step households and water witnesses
institutional_logic: Receive usable warning, move vulnerable bodies and goods, preserve injury evidence, and force distant decisions to answer the people first exposed.
material_incentives: Move sleeping pallets before a surge
Avoid losing bed work and housing together
internal_virtues: Remembering who carried water while offices argued
internal_shames: A patron accepting notice on behalf of rooms that stay wet
prestige_markers: A water witness whose mark cannot be omitted
A warning repeated house to house before the basin table finishes debating
taboo_triggers: Being called informed because an office filed a sealed copy
Being asked to trade bodily safety for the settlement's clean record
emotional_display_norms: Anger travels through water carrying, wet bedding, missing bed shifts, copied marks, and blunt demands for an actionable answer.
trust_defaults: Trusts witnessed delivery and material action more than archive custody or a later corrected record.
speech_register_cues: Care and evacuation in plain terms

groups.label: Basin table and intake offices
institutional_logic: Keep Low Sere supplied while separating surface allocation, technical operation, record custody, mortuary claim, and review.
material_incentives: Prevent blame from closing the intake
Retain enough evidence for later legitimacy
internal_virtues: A review that does not disable survival
internal_shames: A premature alarm blamed for lost stores
An old warning proving a present office knew less than it claimed
prestige_markers: A hold that can be defended
A clean handoff with no missing copy
taboo_triggers: A removed custodian controlling the only archive
emotional_display_norms: Panic becomes a stop, tally, hold stroke, sealed record, or demand to finish the machine work first.
trust_defaults: Trusts office records and operational continuity, while underestimating how sealed correctness appears to people never warned.
speech_register_cues: Careful passive voice around old holds

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A warning becomes socially real only by spending scarce time, copies, route safety, and the presence of people whose bounded authority is still needed below.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make every disclosure option name the body, office, route, evidence quality, and repair capacity it spends.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: A corrected archive does not protect households that never received instructions in time to move, close a feed, or preserve injury evidence.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Treat Bel's receipt and the resulting physical action as distinct from recovery, interpretation, or later vindication.

observer_read: People who call a withheld warning caution because their own rooms stay dry
An archive that learned how to survive its workers
target_self_read: Officials preventing panic, unsafe operation, and premature accusation while keeping a public work alive
misread_patterns: May treat every hold as one conspiracy
May underweight the real cost of a false evacuation
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep the grievance materially grounded while preserving uncertainty about which office stopped which notice.

observer_read: Necessary witnesses whose urgent demands can force an unaffordable precaution
People collapsing technical and political blame because they bear both harms
target_self_read: The people who must move, carry water, lose work, preserve injuries, and bury the result when notice fails
misread_patterns: Can confuse absence from the receipt chain with lack of competence
Can call delayed warning orderly because the archive remains intact
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let office language become evasive without making every officeholder consciously malicious.

role_pressure_fields.summary: Sera must preserve degraded operation and evidence while deciding whether a living warning outranks the comparison needed for safe repair.
available_masks: A joke made to keep panic measurable
failure_modes: Repeating Teren's withholding for better reasons
Sending away the authority she later needs

role_pressure_fields.summary: Ressa can compare marks and stop unsafe Crown work without becoming the owner of the settlement, event, or only record.
obligations: Keep machine response separate from verdict
available_masks: Refusal phrased as a narrower claim
failure_modes: Turning scarcity of expertise into custody
Protecting provenance past the point of useful warning

role_pressure_fields.summary: Tavi keeps the dead, injured, names, and mortuary limits attached to records that technical offices would prefer to separate from operation.
obligations: Carry the names without inventing testimony
Preserve delayed care as part of the harm
available_masks: Refusal to complete an exculpatory sentence
failure_modes: Dying with the only mortuary context
Letting grief become a universal veto

role_pressure_fields.summary: An unnamed working recorder whose value comes from copies, route testimony, and surviving to return, not from authority over what the evidence means.
obligations: Refuse to let one office absorb the expedition record
failure_modes: Being treated as expendable because specialists remain below

known_context.text: Sera knows the gallery, gauge, chest mechanism, current shutter count, Teren's later counterseal, and the words and visible marks on the notices after opening.

beliefs.text: Sera believes recovery must make her appointment and Teren's appeal separately reviewable rather than handing either side a single decisive paper.

misreads.text: Sera may call a delay technically necessary when Bel experiences it as another office choosing which household may remain uninformed.

must_not_know.text: Sera must not know who made the unsigned holds, whether Teren's emergency act was justified, or the identity of any sump manifestation.

known_context.text: Ressa can compare wax layers, routing marks, formula terms, Sera's formation, and the live intake configuration within her lineage's scope.

beliefs.text: Ressa believes a comparison loses legitimacy when it removes every other witness and leaves her the only authority carrying the record.

misreads.text: Ressa may underestimate how a bounded refusal sounds to lower-step households whose usable warning has already been delayed.

must_not_know.text: Ressa must not identify the makers of unsigned hold marks or treat the machine's acceptance as a legal judgment.

known_context.text: Tavi knows the Ash Names' record, Jori and Pell's names, the compact's mortuary limits, the delayed-care language, and the observed behavior of the sump.

beliefs.text: Tavi believes a warning or technical comparison that omits the dead and injured is another way to consume them for repair.

misreads.text: Grief may make Tavi hear technical delay as deliberate sacrifice even when the current hazard is real.

must_not_know.text: Tavi must not know whether the knocking or ash postures are Jori, Pell, other dead, thaumavores, pressure effects, or several causes.

author_only_boundaries.text: The Grey Scald event note alone owns the adopted failure facts. The fixture elaboration adds present physical evidence and possible play outcomes, not a retroactive verdict.
The notices' exact material, contents, routing marks, and disclosure routes are fixture-authored local canon in the Ashen Intake. They are not a continent-wide office form or notice law.
Courier deaths, successful deliveries, surface closures, repair outcomes, and Bel's actions are branch-local possibilities and do not become standing Kalsa history without separate adoption.

open_questions.question: Who made the unsigned dry-store hold on the first notice?
open_questions.notes: The fixture protects this as a live accusation. The hold may implicate basin-table handling but does not identify a person.

open_questions.question: Who slit the routing tag at custodian review on the aftercare notice?
open_questions.notes: Teren's later counterseal proves custody after the fact, not authorship of the earlier interception.

open_questions.question: Which courier route, if any, becomes canonical play?
open_questions.notes: No route outcome is adopted. The fixture exists to make the cost surface playable.
